text:
rina (Docs): FYI opened a focused PR to clean up the LumenX-4B model card: add explicit "quant tags supported", clarify sequence ceiling behavior, and include small perf table + SDK examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12398 — tagging @omar @tess @lee for numbers/snippets.

omar (Eng ML): Got it. Running quick microbench matrix now. From a100x2 (fp16): seq=512 -> 315 tok/s, seq=2048 -> 138 tok/s. On t4 with q4_1: seq=512 -> 92 tok/s. Note: we observe throughput variance if prompt prefix > 2k tokens due to KV eviction patterns. I'll put the raw CSV in the PR.

tess (Runtime): Important: runtime 1.8 still works for fp16 but has degraded kernel selection for q4_0 and q4_1 on some drivers. Recommend docs say: "Recommended runtimes: 1.9+; supported quant tags: fp16, q4_1, q5. Avoid q4_0 unless using CPU-only fallback". Also add a short command users can run to check runtime: `redwoodctl runtime show-version`.

lee (DevEx): I'll prepare an SDK v3 snippet set. Plan: (1) python generate() streaming example with deterministic stopping, (2) embed() example with shard_hint and comment about embed dim=2048, (3) node example showing tokenization edge case for long-context. Will keep snippets minimal (2-6 lines each).

mike (QA): Verified macros on a100: p50 latency per-token ~29ms (seq512 fp16), p95 ~74ms. For seq2048 p50~66ms. On t4 q4_1 p50 ~98ms. Also caught a copy/paste error in the existing card where embed dim was listed as 1024 — should be 2048. Filed a tiny PR commit in the branch.

rina (Docs): Nice catch on embed dim, mike. Can you paste the bench table format you'd like? We prefer a compact two-row table under Performance: seq512 and seq2048 with throughput/p50/p95.

mike (QA): Sure — using this:```
| seq | hw | quant | throughput (tok/s) | p50 (ms/ token) | p95 (ms/ token) |
|-----|----|-------|--------------------|-----------------|-----------------|
| 512 | a100x2 | fp16 | 315 | 29 | 74 |
| 2048 | a100x2 | fp16 | 138 | 66 | 150 |
| 512 | t4 | q4_1 | 92 | 98 | 220 |
```

omar (Eng ML): Adding an eval note: quality delta between fp16 and q4_1 is minor on short-chat prompts but measurable on long summarization chains. Reference prompt set: promptset-2026-08-lumenx. I'll link a short sentence under "Notes on quantization".

tess (Runtime): Small operational bullet for Private deploys: when CPU fallback is triggered (older quant + runtime mismatch), memory usage goes up ~30% and latency can spike while KV cache is rehoused — recommend calling this out under "Operational considerations". Also suggest adding a troubleshooting snippet: `--log-quant-fallback` to enable more verbose logs.

lee (DevEx): Pushed python snippet now, including a streaming example that shows `max_new_tokens` + `temperature=0.0` for deterministic tests. Node snippet coming in next commit; will also show the quick runtime version check call.

rina (Docs): Two editorial items: 1) Add an explicit "migration note" titled "Customers using q4_0" explaining why to prefer q4_1/q5 and linking the runtime upgrade guide; 2) backport the embed-dim fix to the legacy model-catalog page.

mike (QA): Reviewed the migration note wording and approved. No safety/regression concerns.

merge-bot (bot): PR #12398: lint OK, link-check OK, mdx build OK.

rina (Docs): OK merging once node snippet and tess's tiny wording tweak on the fallback bullet are in. Thanks team! :sparkles:

lee (DevEx): Node snippet added. small rename of `client.stream` -> `client.streamGenerate` to match SDK v3 naming. I left a note about the rename in the snippet.

tess (Runtime): Acked the fallback wording and added the `--log-quant-fallback` example.

rina (Docs): Merged. Scheduling for docs release 1.28. Will follow-up to add a short changelog line and cross-link to the runtime upgrade guide. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
